works.title: The Triads
works.subtitle: Classics of Western Spirituality
works.author: Gregory Palamas
works.blurb: Palamas's defense of the hesychasts, distinguishing God's unknowable essence from His uncreated energies in which we truly partake. The cornerstone text of Orthodox theology of theosis.

works.title: Saint Gregory Palamas and Orthodox Spirituality
works.author: John Meyendorff
works.blurb: Meyendorff's accessible introduction to the spiritual world from which Palamas wrote, monastic, sacramental, and rooted in the prayer of the heart.

works.title: The Mystical Theology of the Eastern Church
works.author: Vladimir Lossky
works.blurb: Lossky's classic exposition of Orthodox dogmatic theology read through the prism of the essence-energies distinction: apophasis, the Trinity, the economy of the Son and the Spirit, the deifying union. The book that introduced the Palamite vision to the modern West.

works.title: The Vision of God
works.author: Vladimir Lossky
works.blurb: Lossky traces the patristic doctrine of seeing God from the Apologists through the Cappadocians and Maximus to its synthesis in Palamas, a short history of one question read across the whole Greek Fathers.

works.title: Aristotle East and West
works.subtitle: Metaphysics and the Division of Christendom
works.author: David Bradshaw
works.blurb: Bradshaw traces the divergent reception of Aristotle's energeia in East and West, from the Cappadocians and Dionysius through Maximus to Palamas, set against the parallel Western trajectory through Augustine and Aquinas. The rigorous philosophical case for the essence-energies distinction.

works.title: A Study of Gregory Palamas
works.author: John Meyendorff
works.blurb: The first full English study of Palamas's life and work, originally published in French in 1959 and hailed at the time as a major contribution to Western understanding of Eastern Christianity. The starting point for any serious reading of Palamite theology.

works.title: Gregory Palamas and the Making of Palamism in the Modern Age
works.subtitle: Changing Paradigms in Historical and Systematic Theology
works.author: Norman Russell
works.blurb: Russell's recent study examines how 'Palamism' was constructed in the twentieth century by Western and Eastern theologians for polemical and apologetic purposes, then returns to Palamas himself to read his tradition, philosophy, and theology on their own terms.

works.title: Essence and Energies: Being and Naming God in St. Gregory Palamas
works.subtitle: Routledge Research in Byzantine Studies
works.author: Tikhon Alexander Pino
works.blurb: Pino's comprehensive account of the essence-energies distinction across Palamas's twenty-five treatises and letters, written over twenty years, the standard scholarly treatment for the modal grammar of the distinction. The book to read alongside the florilegium on this profile.
